name: DFW Quiet Qualifier 2024

venue.name: The University of Texas at Dallas, ECSS 2.412
venue.address: Engineering and Computer Science Building, 838 Franklyn Jenifer Dr, Richardson, TX 75080
venue.details: Entering ECSS from the south, 2.412 is the second room on the right

information:
This is a "quiet" competition competition and does not feature standard events like 3x3 and 2x2. For first-timers or those looking for a more typical competition experience, check out any of the [many other competitions happening in Texas](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=USA&search=Texas&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&show_registration_status=on&display=list), including [DFW Cubing Spring 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWCubingSpring2024) the day after on April 28th.
​
Only 2 guests per competitor will be permitted. Please consider coming without guests as spectator seating will be limited.
​
This competition is supported by Southern Cubing LLC. To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).
